import torch
from torch import nn

from models import GROUPNORM_VAE
from train_functions import train_vae,train_capacity_vae
from data_loading import ChunkedShapes3DDataset, transforms_pipeline_bce
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

torch.manual_seed(42)

LR_RATE=1e-4
BATCH_SIZE=128
N_EPOCHS=45
MAX_CAPACITY = 45.0
GAMMA = 140.0
ANNEALING_EPOCHS = 22

DEVICE='cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model=GROUPNORM_VAE(10)
optimizer=torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(),lr=LR_RATE)
dataset=ChunkedShapes3DDataset(transform=transforms_pipeline_bce)
data_loader=DataLoader(dataset,batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, pin_memory=True)
scheduler=torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau( optimizer, mode='min', factor=0.4, patience=2)
test_image=next(iter(data_loader))[0]

Dataset inizializzato: 480000 immagini totali. Chunk size: 10000

generate(model,device=DEVICE,num_samples=3)
img1,img2=next(iter(data_loader))[1],next(iter(data_loader))[1]
interpolate_images(model,img1,img2,steps=10,device=DEVICE)

means,stds=compute_latent_statistics(model,data_loader,DEVICE,10)

with torch.no_grad():
    model.eval()
    mu_test,_=model.encode(test_image.unsqueeze(0).to(DEVICE))
test_all_latents(model,mu_test,means,stds,0,2,20,DEVICE)
